options.act: App Intents: open cards, answer, send
options.label: Shortcuts and Siri

why: The Record in Spotlight. Every decision is indexed (CoreSpotlight), so ⌘Space "12-hour" finds the card, what you picked and why, months later. App Intents give Shortcuts and Siri What needs me?, Answer card and Send answers, so a morning Shortcut can read the count aloud. Things, OmniFocus and Bear do the same.
Inside the app, ⌘K jumps to any card, phase or decision across projects, like Xcode's Open Quickly or Linear's ⌘K.
